items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: Before that, it was Bird and Hawkins and then a lot of those other guys like that.

ctx.x: But I just started hearing about him in the last five or six years. Before that, it was Bird and Hawkins and then a lot of those other guys like that. Prez and all those. I was very much familiar with him, but I wasn't very familiar with Coltrane. The fact is, I don't think I'd heard him more than once or twice until I heard your show. And then I listened to the whole show. I said, well, I want to find out what this guy does. And I listened to the whole show. And some things he did real nice, and some things he…
Well, some of the earlier things he did, as you heard, were very melodic, lyrical.
